why_ai: Screen work with no licence, but buyers pay the project's creators for hosting and expertise.
why_clarity: Adoption is invisible and conversion unmeasurable, so commercial success is hard to check.
why_digital: Code and community data in, software and hosted services out, sold online.

why_ai: Inferring who runs the software from public signals and telemetry is analytics AI does well.
why_clarity: Usage targets are clear, but confirming who actually runs the software is hard.
why_digital: Public signals and telemetry in, adoption analytics out, entirely digital.

why_ai: Choosing how to monetise free software against hyperscalers is a strategic, adversarial bet.
why_clarity: Few, strategic model decisions whose revenue consequences take years to show.
why_digital: Software licensed or hosted and sold online to platform teams.

why_ai: Reading a large public textual corpus for intelligence is exactly what language models do.
why_clarity: The corpus is large and recurring, but the useful outputs are not yet defined.
why_digital: Public issues, chats and code in, intelligence reports out, all digital.

why_ai: Identical answers written twice across tickets and issues are ideal for AI support agents.
why_clarity: The same questions recur and each answer is verifiable against the software.
why_digital: Tickets and public issues in, written answers out, all online.

why_ai: Lawyers sign off, but licence analysis and dependency provenance are mechanical checks software runs.
why_clarity: Licence obligations and provenance follow defined rules, repeated across every component.
why_digital: Licences and dependency data in, review approvals out, handled remotely.

why_ai: Customers who refuse to operate software keep paying someone to run it, and creators earn trust.
why_clarity: Uptime, latency and SLAs give exact, continuously measured success.
why_digital: Managed software service delivered and bought entirely online.

why_ai: Classification, deduplication and answering of issues are mature AI tasks.
why_clarity: A huge queue of similar issues with quick, checkable triage outcomes.
why_digital: Issues and pull requests in, labels and replies out, all online.

why_ai: Dependence is measurable from public data, but funding allocation involves judgment and funder trust.
why_clarity: Whether funding prevented a failure is known slowly, if ever.
why_digital: Dependency graphs and project health data in, funding decisions out, all remote.

why_ai: Drawing the free-versus-paid line is a contested judgment that must keep the community's tolerance.
why_clarity: The boundary is redrawn by argument every two years with no agreed measure.
why_digital: Feature usage and licences in, commercial editions out, sold online.

why_ai: A specific trusted maintainer holds the project together; AI eases the load but not the role.
why_clarity: Queue work recurs and is checkable, but sustainability as an outcome is vague.
why_digital: Issues and code in, releases and reviews out, entirely online.
